jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Creative Fabrication & Experiential Production
jobs.description:
**SCPS Unlimited | Torrance, CA | Full-Time | Onsite | Monday–Friday**

**Help Bring Ambitious Creative Projects to Life**

At SCPS Unlimited, we turn imaginative concepts into physical reality. From experiential installations and scenic fabrication to custom props, prototypes, and one-of-a-kind creations, our projects combine creativity, engineering, craftsmanship, and problem-solving.

No two projects are exactly alike, and that's what makes our work exciting.

We're looking for an experienced **Project Coordinator** who understands physical production, enjoys working with creative and technical teams, and knows how to keep multiple moving parts organized.

You'll work closely with Project Managers, Project Leads, designers, fabricators, and vendors to help bring projects from concept through fabrication, delivery, and installation.

**What You'll Do**

* Coordinate and maintain project schedules, production timelines, milestones, and crew assignments using input from Project Managers and Project Leads.
* Track project progress, priorities, approvals, and outstanding action items, proactively identifying potential delays or conflicts.
* Coordinate sourcing, purchasing, and delivery of materials, components, equipment, and services based on project requirements.
* Research vendors, obtain quotes, and support project estimates and purchasing decisions.
* Maintain bills of materials, purchasing records, and project documentation while monitoring costs against approved budgets.
* Coordinate vendors, subcontractors, equipment rentals, freight, shipping, travel, and installation logistics.
* Organize project briefs, drawings, client communications, revisions, and approved changes.
* Support Project Managers with scheduling, meetings, project updates, and client-facing documentation.
* Coordinate project closeout activities, including delivery records, rental returns, final documentation, and outstanding items.
* Anticipate project needs, communicate potential issues early, and help keep teams aligned and moving forward.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience coordinating projects involving **custom fabrication, scenic production, experiential installations, exhibits, themed entertainment, custom manufacturing, or similar physical production environments**.
* Working knowledge of fabrication materials, processes, vendors, and production workflows.
* Experience with purchasing, vendor coordination, scheduling, and production logistics.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects with changing priorities.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and follow-through.
* Ability to work independently within assigned responsibilities while collaborating closely with project and fabrication teams.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace; Adobe Creative Suite experience is a plus.
* Comfortable working between an office environment and an active fabrication shop.

You don't need to be a fabricator, but you should understand how physical projects move from design and sourcing through fabrication, delivery, and installation.

**Why Join SCPS?**

At SCPS, you'll be part of a creative, collaborative environment where ideas become tangible experiences.

Our projects span different industries, materials, and technical challenges, offering opportunities to expand your knowledge and work alongside talented designers, fabricators, and production professionals.

You'll have meaningful responsibility, contribute directly to project success, and see the results of your work come to life.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $28–$38 per hour, depending on relevant experience and qualifications.
* Full-time, nonexempt position with overtime paid in accordance with applicable law.
* Monday–Friday, onsite at our Torrance, California facility.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your experience supporting fabrication, scenic, experiential, or other physical production projects.

We'd especially like to hear about a project where you helped coordinate materials, schedules, vendors, or production logistics to meet a challenging deadline.

Pay: $28.00 - $38.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

As a Business Development Representative (Strategic Growth Partner) at Compass International Holdings, you are the face of the company and the engine of our market expansion, directly responsible for driving net-new pipeline for our Strategic Growth Team. In its simplest form, you will educate our agent community on the benefits and importance of contributing to the Strategic Growth of Compass International Holdings, identifying who in their network of prospective agents should be introduced to our closing team.

SGPs are the future of the Strategic Growth organization. In addition to the direct impact this role has as a partner to the Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs) in the market, you will ultimately be working toward the goal of becoming an SGM yourself. * Partner with Agents to identify referral opportunities and seamlessly transition them to a Strategic Growth Manager for full-cycle closing.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Growth Managers and Team Leaders to develop successful prospecting strategies, adding value to each SGM’s sales process.
* Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up communications.
* Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
* Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.

* A formal SGP-to-SGM training program designed to fast-track your career into a closing sales position.
* Direct partnership and mentorship from top-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
* A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
* Operate with a "glass-half-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.

**How You’ll Be Measured** This role is measured by pipeline generation and the volume of qualified opportunities successfully created for the Strategic Growth Managers.

* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities.

**Compensation** The base pay range for this position is $38.46–$43.27 per hour ($80,000–$90,000 annualized); with an annual target bonus of $10K-$15K and uncapped bonus potential. We provide a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Cancer Research and Training
jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  
  
To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

The Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) is a campus-wide multidisciplinary matrix organization whose goal is to promote and enhance cancer- relevant research and patient care at UC Irvine. The CFCCC provides research resources to its 250+ faculty and clinician members and offers multidisciplinary cancer care to its patients.

  
Responsibilities:

Uses skills as a seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of analytical practices, policies and procedures; researches, analyzes and develops solutions to a wide range of issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Primarily deals with policies, programs and proposals which are complex in nature and diverse in scope. Develops new programs, policies or procedures for possible implementation.
  
  
The Coordinator reports to the Manager, Cancer Research and Training and supports a portfolio of programs and activities at the UCI Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) that advance cancer research and training initiatives. The Coordinator assists with the implementation, coordination, administration, tracking, monitoring and evaluation of education, training, and research support programs aligned with Cancer Center priorities. This includes the following:
  
  
Training and Education
  

* Coordinate and administer education, training and workforce development portfolio across the cancer career continuum (from high school to faculty levels) spanning basic, translational, clinical and population science.
* Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of cancer- focused education and training initiatives, including experiential summer training programs for high school students, undergraduate research training, faculty leadership and mentorship development programs, and educational activities such as journal clubs, seminars, symposia, lectures and workshops.
* Collect and organize program information to support identification of gaps in the training pathway and coordinate new initiatives to address these gaps
* Coordinate and support education and training activities across the Cancer Center, to ensure integration with the three Research Programs, eight Shared Resource units, the Community Outreach and Engagement Office and the Sue & Ralph Stern Center for Cancer Clinical Trials & Research.
* Engage faculty, trainees and institutional partners to expand participation and strengthen interdisciplinary training opportunities.
* Assist in ensuring education, training and workforce development activities align with Cancer Center strategic priorities, NIH expectations, and NCI Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) requirements.

  
  
Research Oversight and Support
  

* Provide administration and operations for programs and initiatives that support cancer research activities, support services, research development, training grants and collaborative funding opportunities.
* Assist with coordination of cancer-focused training and research funding mechanisms, including T32 programs, R25 initiatives, ACS-IRG, ACS-DICR and related research support services.
* Support logistics and coordination for the development of programs and resources that support research activities, support services, and collaborative and multidisciplinary cancer research funding proposals.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for activities that strengthen research and grant competitiveness, including pilot support, mentoring structures, proposal development efforts and coordination with institutional research development service units.
* Track and monitor program performance, funding outcomes and alignment with Cancer Center research priorities.

  
Program Evaluation, Tracking and Outcomes Monitoring
  

* Assist in maintaining systems to monitor participation, outcomes and program impact across research and training initiatives.
* Coordinate data collection and documentation to support tracking and monitoring of trainee progression across the cancer career pipeline, including academic advancement, publications, funding success and career placement.
* Track, monitor and organize program metrics to inform program improvement and decision-making.
* Assist in preparation of reports, summaries and documentation for leadership, university units (e.g., Office of Research, School of Medicine, etc.), advisory committees and external funding agencies, including materials supporting NCI CCSG and training grant reporting requirements.

  
These are mandatory components of the National Cancer Institute (NCI) P30 Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) and are vital to NCI’s continued designation to the CFCCC. The NCI designation has a vital reputational and financial impact for CFCCC, UCI and UCI Health. Adherence to the guidelines of the CCSG is mandatory and involves ongoing monitoring of the organization for structure, direction, and fiscal management. All decisions at the CFCCC are taken within the context of the CCSG requirements.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across UC Irvine and the Health System with leadership, faculty, staff and students.
* Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job.
*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Weave (YC W25) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration.

Trusted by 200+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double-digit month-over-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth.

As Weave's Customer Success Manager, you'll own everything that happens after a customer signs. You'll get customers live fast, turn Weave into a weekly habit for their engineering managers, and make sure every account renews and grows.

We've raised a $13.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, Y Combinator, Moonfire, Burst Capital, IrregEx and the Agent Fund.

This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work.

**WHAT WE'RE BUILDING**
-----------------------

Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles.

We use AI to:

* Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship)
* Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact
* Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance

Today that means two products: the Weave platform, which shows engineering leaders how AI is changing their team's output, quality and token spend, and the open-source Weave Router, which routes each coding-agent prompt to the right model based on cost, speed and quality.

**THE TEAM YOU'LL WORK WITH**
-----------------------------

You'll work directly with:

* Adam (CEO): leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high-growth startups who has scaled multiple sales teams from $0 to $30M in ARR, and he stays deeply embedded with customers.
* Andrew (CTO): previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew is deeply committed to mentorship and ownership for everyone on the team, and will be your closest partner on getting more technical fast.

You'll also work side by side with our sales team and engineers every day.

This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one.

**THE ROLE**
------------

This isn't a traditional customer success role. You'll be as comfortable debugging an integration as you are running a renewal call. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of account manager, solutions engineer and data analyst.

Every customer buys Weave to answer some version of the same question: "is AI actually making our engineering team better, and is it worth what we're spending?" Your job is to make sure they get an answer they trust, and then act on it.

You'll own a book of our largest accounts from kickoff to renewal, from fast-growing startups to public companies like Robinhood. You'll also build the onboarding and automation that covers every other customer. You'll be measured on whether customers stay, whether usage spreads from the leader who bought Weave to the managers who run their teams with it every week, and whether accounts grow.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

* **Get customers live fast.** Run onboarding end to end, from connecting GitHub and AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor to their first executive report.
* **Drive adoption past the buyer.** Train engineering managers and tech leads until Weave is part of their 1:1s, sprint reviews and planning.
* **Be the expert on the data.** Help customers read their metrics, run business reviews on what changed, and dig in when a number looks wrong.
* **Own renewals and expansion.** Track account health, find the next champion when one leaves, and partner with sales to grow accounts.
* **Close the loop with engineering.** Triage and reproduce issues, write bug reports engineers can act on, and bring customer patterns back to the roadmap.
* **Build the playbook.** Onboarding checklists, health scores and help docs, automated wherever possible.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

### **MUST-HAVE**

* 2+ years in a post-sale, customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company: customer success, account management, implementation, solutions or support.
* You've owned a book of business. You were measured on renewals, retention or expansion, and you can walk us through your numbers and the accounts you saved.
* You're technical enough to unblock customers. You don't need to have been an engineer, but you know how software teams ship (PRs, code review, CI/CD, incidents), you're at home in GitHub, and when an integration breaks, you dig in before you escalate.
* You use AI tools every day. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar are part of how you work, and you have real opinions about what they're good at.
* You write and speak clearly. You can walk a CTO through a messy dataset in a few minutes, and write the follow-up that gets everyone aligned.
* Self-starter who's comfortable in ambiguity and wired for speed.
* This role is 5 days in office in SF

### **NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Hands-on technical experience. You've worked as a software engineer, support engineer, solutions engineer or forward deployed engineer, or you've shipped code as part of your job.
* You can write SQL or a quick Python script to answer your own questions.
* Customer success experience at a developer tools, data or AI company where your users were engineers
* Real opinions on DORA, SPACE and DevEx, and on what changes when agents write half the code
* You've built customer success from zero: onboarding programs, health scores, QBR templates, help docs
* Experience at an early-stage startup (Seed to Series B)

**WHY JOIN**
------------

* $120K-$150K base salary + early equity
* Health/vision/dental insurance covered
* Free lunch/dinners/snacks
* Yearly team offsite with regular team events
* Yearly $500 learning/develo

jobs.title: Social Media & Influencer Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Social Media & Influencer Partnerships Coordinator supports Food Bank For New York City’s social media presence through content creation, cultural trendspotting, and relationship-building with creators, influencers, talent, public figures, and mission-aligned partners. This role helps expand awareness, engagement, and support for Food Bank’s mission by combining social media execution with partnership development.

The ideal candidate is a social-first communications professional who can identify opportunities in culture, create compelling content, and cultivate authentic partnerships, while ensuring all storytelling remains thoughtful, inclusive, and dignity-centered.

This role requires regular, in-person presence across New York City for events, activations, and field content. Candidates must be based in the NYC metro area.

-

**Key Responsibilities**

***Content & Social Media***

* Support the creation of engaging, platform-appropriate content, including copy, graphics, carousels, Reels, Stories, and short-form video.
* Produce original content under the direction of the Senior Social Media Manager and in alignment with campaign goals, editorial direction, brand voice, and organizational priorities.

* Elevate the voices and experiences of neighbors, community partners, volunteers, and staff through respectful, dignity-centered storytelling.

* Schedule and publish approved content across social platforms.

* Help maintain content calendars and campaign timelines.

* Oversee community management across all platforms, monitoring comments, DMs, mentions, and relevant conversations, responding where appropriate and escalating sensitive or high-risk issues.

* Stay current on social media trends, cultural moments, platform changes, and emerging formats, proactively bringing forward thoughtful, mission-aligned opportunities for Food Bank to engage.

***Events & Field Content***

* Support social media coverage of events, activations, press moments, volunteer opportunities, and partner visits across NYC.

* Capture photos and videos and help turn events and activations into timely social content.

* Conduct or support short, informal interviews with volunteers, neighbors, partners, staff, and, when appropriate, public figures or celebrities.

* Organize and share captured photos, video, and other assets with the Senior Social Media Manager and Communications team.

***Influencer, Talent & Cultural Partnerships***

* Stay highly attuned to NYC events, pop culture, entertainment, food, music, sports, and emerging talent to identify relevant content, partnership, and activation opportunities.

* Identify and research creators, influencers, comedians, chefs, athletes, celebrities, and cultural tastemakers whose audiences and values align with Food Bank's mission.

* Monitor concerts, comedy shows, cultural events, restaurant openings, festivals, and other high-profile NYC moments for potential opportunities.

* Support creator, influencer, and talent engagement efforts by researching prospects, drafting outreach, coordinating communications, tracking relationships, and helping move opportunities from initial contact to activation.

* Maintain organized trackers and databases for talent, influencers, partnerships, outreach, events, and engagement.

* 1–3 years of experience in social media, digital communications, content creation, marketing, journalism, or a related field.

* Comfortable creating and editing short-form photo and video content.
* Proactive and curious, with the ability to identify opportunities and bring forward ideas.

Chemlu Developmental Disabilities Center / Maaluh  
$28–$32 per hour (about $58,240–$66,560 per year) | Full-time, 40 hours per week | Field-based, NYC and Rockland County

Do you know the OPWDD system from the care management or intake side? This role puts that experience to work connecting families with developmental disability services, and you won't carry a caseload.

jobs.title: Employee Benefits Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding an Employee Benefits Account Manager** **to their** **Corporate Synergies** **team in the New York City** **Metro Region.**

The Account Manager is a client-facing position responsible for managing day-to-day service activities for an assigned book of business. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and Underwriting, this role supports client retention, satisfaction, and growth through proactive relationship management and service delivery.

**Essential Functions:**

* Manage the client life-cycle deliverables with oversight from the Benefit Consultant and Team Lead to ensure the successful retention of a Book of Business (94% Renewal Rate).
* With guidance and supervision, work on client related deliverables of increasing complexity.
* Beyond foundational knowledge (i.e., industry, product knowledge and regulatory compliance), complete necessary training and professional development to gain exposure to principles such as strategic account planning, effective communication and project management.
* Identify and declare area of focus/subject matter expertise.
* Maintain up-to-date client files/internal systems in accordance with CSG's standard protocols.
* Compliance with CSG's processes and operating standards.

**Essential Duties:**

* As part of the client life cycle (on-boarding, ongoing support and renewal), work closely with the Team to execute on the day-to-day service deliverables for ALL lines of coverage and products by:
  + Supporting the Team Lead to understand a client's goals/objectives and develop a multi-year strategic plan (roadmap)
  + Defining an annual service delivery calendar (life cycle) in support of the multi-year strategic plan (roadmap)
  + Preparing the various deliverables by leveraging team member expertise, available tools, established standards/work products, etc. to manage client expectations and ensure timely delivery of materials in accordance with the client life cycle
  + Effectively communicating and presenting findings, analysis and recommendations in meetings/calls/emails (i.e., setting agendas and appropriate internal/external follow-up)
  + Prepare standard and ad-hoc reports and other client related projects (as needed)
  + Developing, cultivating and maintaining strong client/vendor relationships
* At various times throughout the year (i.e., Open Enrollment), review employee education and communication materials (i.e., Benefit Guides).
* Research, respond and/or resolve client inquiries/service-related issues independently, involving more experienced team members and resources when necessary.
* Maintain internal systems (i.e., BenefitPoint and Oracle) and client files in accordance with CSG's data standards and filing requirements.
* Ensure that contact information for all client stakeholders is appropriately managed for purposes of both Client Satisfaction (NPS) and Thought Leadership.
* In order to identify/overcome gaps, work with Team Lead and Producer to create and periodically review/update/manage Internal Account Plan.
* Interact with carriers and vendors on behalf of the client and the team.
* Ability to identify and leverage resources appropriate for upsell opportunities.
* Responsible for reconciling client revenue monthly (BenefitPoint vs. Finance Accrued Revenue).
* Develop new and creative benefit solutions with guidance.

**Competencies & Qualifications:**

* Strong attention to detail, well organized and responsive
* Ability to model financial implications from benefit programs
* Comfortable in negotiating with insurance carriers
* Ability to identify problems and create effective solutions
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to quickly learn new skills
* Works collaboratively with a team as well as independently, capable of meeting deadlines and delegating when necessary,
* Ability to establish relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and demonstrate composure/resilience under pressure - Comfortable switching between clients and tasks to meet deadlines
* Possesses a basic understanding of general business and financial concepts
* Ability to effectively create, organize and manage a project plan
* Basic understanding of strategy and long-term planning

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* 3+ years of prior practical account management experience with a health and welfare carrier or broker is required
* State Specific Resident Life & Health License is required

**Disclaimer:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**

FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.

**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays & 2 floating holidays!

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Oath**

Oath is the strategic giving platform designed to help donors maximize the impact of their contributions by guiding them to the races and causes where their dollars can make the greatest impact. Oath has directed over $150M while protecting donors' data and avoiding the spam and spin of other giving platforms. As the one stop shop for a generation of donors who want to make a difference, Oath is building the future of philanthropy.

### **The Opportunity**

You'll run the channels that bring new grassroots donors into Oath and turn existing donors into recruiters. Your mission is to grow Oath's donor base through paid media and peer-to-peer programs while building a community of donors who share Oath with their networks. The role is about 70% paid media and peer-to-peer marketing and 30% community building. You'll own budgets, test fast, and report what works, with the 2028 presidential cycle as the biggest acquisition moment in Oath's history. You'll have the autonomy to build these programs your way, with the support of the Head of Growth and a team across email, social, and creator partnerships.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the donor journey**: Own the experience from first impression to sign-up, including what donors see in ads and how they experience Oath at every step after.
* **Own paid media**: Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google, and emerging platforms. Own budget allocation, targeting, creative testing, pacing, forecasting, and cost-per-donor goals. Set a specific strategy for each funnel stage, build new audiences to reach new donor archetypes, and plan around reach, saturation, and the cost to acquire a new donor, not just ROAS.
* **Build community, ambassadors, and the peer-to-peer program**: Manage Oath’s community spaces and give donors who want to do more a clear way to get involved. Find, train, and support the volunteer ambassadors and creators who bring new donors to Oath. Launch and run donor-to-donor texting, referral campaigns, giving circles, and shareable race pages that turn donors into bundlers.
* **Write, test, and optimize**: Draft and iterate ad copy, landing pages, and P2P scripts in Oath’s voice: direct, data-grounded, and never alarmist. Work with engineering and product to design landing page tests, run structured A/B tests, and drive conversion rate optimization. Get excited about building and optimizing routines with AI tools.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Work closely with Email & Lifecycle, Social & Creator Partnerships, and Partnerships so every channel tells one story. Be comfortable in HubSpot and collaborate with lifecycle marketing on CRM.
* **Time campaigns and support earned media**: Plan pushes around major national cultural and political events, and help broaden our reach through earned media, exploring new efforts and tracking the results.
* **Report, measure, and iterate**: Own weekly reporting on spend, cost per donor, conversion, and retention by channel, with a clear story of what moved and why. Own measurement across the full top-of-funnel team (community, influencer and affiliate, events), and build a scorecard leadership can trust. Understand our economics well enough to shift budget to what performs.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Strong background**: You have 3+ years in any of the following: paid digital, performance marketing, or digital fundraising (ideally for political, advocacy, or nonprofit organizations); growth roles at leading tech or consumer companies; MBB consulting; investment banking; or VC/PE. Your background signals exceptional caliber.
* **High ba**r: You hold yourself accountable for both quality and results, and you’re comfortable pushing beyond the obvious idea.
* **Hands-on operator**: You have a proven track record managing paid budgets with strong ROI, and you’re data-literate: you can read dashboards, interpret metrics, and turn data into decisions. Hands-on experience with peer-to-peer texting or relational organizing tools is a plus, and so is experience building or moderating online communities.
* **Strong writer**: You’re comfortable drafting and testing creative in a set brand voice.
* **Thinker and doer**: You have a bias toward action, like being scrappy and creative, and connect the dots across the org. No task is too small or too big.
* **Mission-driven and winning mindset**: You’re excited about politics & civic engagement and you get excited about every new donor we reach
* **Management experience**: Have management experience or are open to managing interns!

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Base Salary: $100,000-$125,000
* Equity package
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k) matching
* Time Off: Flexible PTO
* Office: 3 days per week in our NYC headquarters; flexible remote work for the other 2 days

**Operations Coordinator | Kirsten Jordan Team (KJT) at The Corcoran Group**

**Hours:** 9AM–6PM ET, Monday–Friday; occasional evenings/weekends around launches and events

**THE ROLE**

As Operations Coordinator for the Kirsten Jordan Team, you'll work alongside experienced agents, marketing professionals, and transaction specialists, gaining hands-on exposure to every stage of the sales process, from listing preparation and marketing launches to negotiations, contract execution, and closings. You'll have a front-row seat to both the resale and new development businesses while learning how a top-performing team operates at the highest level.

This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who aspires to become a successful New York City real estate agent. Through daily involvement in the team's operations, you'll develop the market knowledge, client service skills, transaction expertise, and professional network that form the foundation of a thriving career at Corcoran.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ambitious professional who enjoys being at the center of a fast-paced business, takes pride in supporting others, and is motivated by the opportunity to learn from some of the best in the industry.

 **Compensation:**

$50,000 - $60,000

 **Responsibilities:**

**WHAT YOU’LL BE ACCOUNTABLE FOR**

* **Listings.** Every listing is launch-ready and accurate, with documents gathered, vendor shoots scheduled, and pricing, status, and open houses correct across CTE, StreetEasy, Corcoran, and our website.
* **Transactions.** Deals stay on track from offer to closing. You work with LC/TC on paperwork and board packages, keep deadlines visible, and let marketing know about key milestones (price changes, In Contract, Sold).

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Listings and deals are organized, accurate, and on schedule. Agents always know where things stand, and marketing gets what it needs without asking twice.

* **30 days:** Up to speed on KJT and Corcoran systems; calendars, listing folders, and trackers are current.
* **60 days:** Core listing, vendor, and production workflows run reliably with little prompting.
* **90 days:** You own day-to-day coordination end-to-end, and the team relies on you as its operational backbone.

 **Qualifications:**

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 1–3 years of experience in real estate coordination, mortgage origination, sales support, operations, or a similar role.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with dependable follow-through on many moving pieces at once.
* A clear communicator who is comfortable working with agents, clients, Corcoran departments, and vendors.
* At ease with digital tools and happy to be hands-on, whether that’s updating a tracker or running a delivery.
* Discreet with confidential client information. Familiarity with NYC real estate systems (CTE, REBNY RLS, StreetEasy) is a plus.

 **About Company**

The Kirsten Jordan Team is one of Manhattan's top-producing luxury real estate teams, representing some of New York City's most notable resale and new development properties. This role is designed for someone who is eager to build a long-term career in real estate and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business from the ground up.

jobs.title: Route Account Executive (Sales & Account Management)
jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Account Executive in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Job Description

The Customer Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and represents their needs throughout the organization. * Experience in customer account management, technical customer service, inside sales, project coordination, or a similar role supporting business customers in manufacturing or an engineered-product environment.

jobs.title: Production Assistant, Live Selling (AM Shift)
jobs.description:
**About ThredUp**

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

**The Role**

ThredUp is turning secondhand browsing into a live, shoppable experience. Buyers watch a real person pull real inventory in real time, and we’re building ThredUp Live from the ground up. As a Production Assistant, you’re the hands-on team that makes every show run. Working inside our distribution center, you’ll reserve and stage the inventory, set up the studio, and run the auctions and chat while we’re live. After each show, you’ll hand items back to the DC team for reinduction. You’ll report to the Live Selling and Social Commerce Manager, who sets the strategy, show plan, and direction for the program. You’ll be the steady on-site presence that makes it happen day after day. This is a full-time, on-site role on our AM shift, and it’s a chance to help build a new business line from the start.

**In This Role You’ll Get To**

* Reserve and stage inventory for each day’s shows, working from the show plan provided by the Live Selling Manager
* Prep the live studio before the first show and reset it between shows so every show starts clean and on time
* Run the auctions during each live show, keeping bidding moving and the pace on track
* Monitor the chat throughout the show, answer viewer questions, and flag requests to the host
* Partner with Live Sellers Hosts and the Live Selling and Social Commerce Manager on show-day decisions, and run show operations on your own on days when the Manager isn’t on-site
* Notify the DC team after every show so items are ready for reinduction
* Track what sold fast, what didn’t, and what viewers asked for, and share it with the Live Selling Manager to help shape the next show

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring full-time **Account Managers** to join our **Schaumburg** team, serving businesses throughout the local area.

In this role, you’ll work directly with business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. You’ll primarily manage existing customer relationships while continuing to grow your portfolio through new business development.

Unlike many sales positions where every month starts at zero, you’ll build a book of business that can continue generating recurring income through customer renewals and long-term relationships, all while helping business owners reduce their overall energy costs.

**Why This Opportunity Is Different**

Many sales jobs focus only on closing the next deal. Here, you’ll build lasting relationships with local business owners while creating a customer portfolio that can continue producing income through future renewals and residual commissions.

Many of our **Account Managers** have been with us for 10+ years because they’ve built a "businesses within the business" — creating recurring income from customer relationships they’ve nurtured over time.

We also believe the best leaders are developed from within. As we continue expanding into more than 20+ markets over the next few years, we’re creating new leadership opportunities for Account Managers who want to grow with us long term.

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. From there, you’ll determine the best way to optimize your day as you crush your goals. Typical responsibilities included:

* Build lasting relationships with existing commercial customers.

* Support customers through future renewals and ongoing energy needs.
* Prospect for new clients by meeting face-to-face with local business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Develop new business opportunities between customer appointments.
* Build and grow your own portfolio of commercial accounts.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

Successful Account Managers come from a variety of backgrounds, but they all enjoy working with people, building relationships, and helping customers find solutions. If you’re someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and the drive to continually improve, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**You bring the work ethic. We’ll provide the training.**

**Compensation**

**Performance-Based Earnings + Residual Income**

* Commission earned on new accounts
* Residual commissions on existing accounts you continue to manage
* Increased earning potential as you build and grow your client portfolio

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $65,000–$90,000, with top performers earning $125,000+ by consistently exceeding performance goals and growing their book of business.**

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Your previous experience gives you a foundation—we’ll help you build on it. You’ll receive **paid, hands-on training** focused on our industry, products, client management process, and approach to growing a book of business.

As you progress, you’ll have access to continued **coaching, mentorship, and professional development** designed to strengthen your skills and prepare you for future opportunities in leadership and business management. Our long-term growth depends on developing talented people who are ready to take on more.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

new_jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

As a Business Development Representative (Strategic Growth Partner) at Compass International Holdings, you are the face of the company and the engine of our market expansion, directly responsible for driving net-new pipeline for our Strategic Growth Team. In its simplest form, you will educate our agent community on the benefits and importance of contributing to the Strategic Growth of Compass International Holdings, identifying who in their network of prospective agents should be introduced to our closing team.

SGPs are the future of the Strategic Growth organization. In addition to the direct impact this role has as a partner to the Strategic Growth Managers (SGMs) in the market, you will ultimately be working toward the goal of becoming an SGM yourself. From onboarding all the way through a formal SGP-to-SGM training program, your focus will be on developing the skills and knowledge that line a direct path into a closing sales position within an incredibly driven, high-performing team.

**What You’ll Do**

* Generate new business opportunities to build a sales pipeline through strategic inbound and outbound efforts.
* Outreach directly to prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods.
* Articulate our value proposition (technology, marketing, culture, and growth) and handle objections to create qualified opportunities in your market.
* Partner with Agents to identify referral opportunities and seamlessly transition them to a Strategic Growth Manager for full-cycle closing.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Growth Managers and Team Leaders to develop successful prospecting strategies, adding value to each SGM’s sales process.
* Drive active engagement with new and existing leads through creative follow-up communications.
* Analyze addressable markets in emergent geographies and create demand for our disruptive technology.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to create new processes and refine existing ones through innovative thinking.
* Document all activities within our CRM, maintaining flawless data management.

**What This Role Offers**

* A formal SGP-to-SGM training program designed to fast-track your career into a closing sales position.
* Direct partnership and mentorship from top-performing Strategic Growth Managers and market leaders.
* A highly collaborative environment where you can actively innovate on processes and outbound strategies.
* Operate with a "glass-half-full" mentality, making a tangible impact on the company's market expansion.

**How You’ll Be Measured** This role is measured by pipeline generation and the volume of qualified opportunities successfully created for the Strategic Growth Managers.

**Location** Based in our Beverly Hills, California office, this onsite role will have you engaging directly with the local Compass Agent Community and collaborating in person with the Strategic Growth team.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2+ years of relevant experience and a history of strong performance (SDR, Customer Success/Service, Direct Sales, Account Management).
* Strong interpersonal and rapport-building skills; a natural leader with a positive, solutions-oriented mentality.
* Self-starter attitude with the ability to exercise judgment, solve difficult problems without direct supervision, and comfortably navigate ambiguity.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to effectively lead client meetings and presentations.
* Highly organized with the ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities.

**Compensation** The base pay range for this position is $38.46–$43.27 per hour ($80,000–$90,000 annualized); with an annual target bonus of $10K-$15K and uncapped bonus potential. We provide a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

**Perks that You Need to Know About:**

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

The CFCCC provides research resources to its 250+ faculty and clinician members and offers multidisciplinary cancer care to its patients.

  
Responsibilities:

Uses skills as a seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of analytical practices, policies and procedures; researches, analyzes and develops solutions to a wide range of issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Primarily deals with policies, programs and proposals which are complex in nature and diverse in scope. Develops new programs, policies or procedures for possible implementation.
  
  
The Coordinator reports to the Manager, Cancer Research and Training and supports a portfolio of programs and activities at the UCI Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (CFCCC) that advance cancer research and training initiatives. The Coordinator assists with the implementation, coordination, administration, tracking, monitoring and evaluation of education, training, and research support programs aligned with Cancer Center priorities. This includes the following:
  
  
Training and Education
  

* Coordinate and administer education, training and workforce development portfolio across the cancer career continuum (from high school to faculty levels) spanning basic, translational, clinical and population science.
* Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of cancer- focused education and training initiatives, including experiential summer training programs for high school students, undergraduate research training, faculty leadership and mentorship development programs, and educational activities such as journal clubs, seminars, symposia, lectures and workshops.
* Collect and organize program information to support identification of gaps in the training pathway and coordinate new initiatives to address these gaps
* Coordinate and support education and training activities across the Cancer Center, to ensure integration with the three Research Programs, eight Shared Resource units, the Community Outreach and Engagement Office and the Sue & Ralph Stern Center for Cancer Clinical Trials & Research.
* Engage faculty, trainees and institutional partners to expand participation and strengthen interdisciplinary training opportunities.
* Assist in ensuring education, training and workforce development activities align with Cancer Center strategic priorities, NIH expectations, and NCI Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) requirements.

  
  
Research Oversight and Support
  

* Provide administration and operations for programs and initiatives that support cancer research activities, support services, research development, training grants and collaborative funding opportunities.
* Assist with coordination of cancer-focused training and research funding mechanisms, including T32 programs, R25 initiatives, ACS-IRG, ACS-DICR and related research support services.
* Support logistics and coordination for the development of programs and resources that support research activities, support services, and collaborative and multidisciplinary cancer research funding proposals.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for activities that strengthen research and grant competitiveness, including pilot support, mentoring structures, proposal development efforts and coordination with institutional research development service units.
* Track and monitor program performance, funding outcomes and alignment with Cancer Center research priorities.

  
Program Evaluation, Tracking and Outcomes Monitoring
  

* Assist in maintaining systems to monitor participation, outcomes and program impact across research and training initiatives.
* Coordinate data collection and documentation to support tracking and monitoring of trainee progression across the cancer career pipeline, including academic advancement, publications, funding success and career placement.
* Track, monitor and organize program metrics to inform program improvement and decision-making.
* Assist in preparation of reports, summaries and documentation for leadership, university units (e.g., Office of Research, School of Medicine, etc.), advisory committees and external funding agencies, including materials supporting NCI CCSG and training grant reporting requirements.

  
These are mandatory components of the National Cancer Institute (NCI) P30 Cancer Center Support Grant (CCSG) and are vital to NCI’s continued designation to the CFCCC. The NCI designation has a vital reputational and financial impact for CFCCC, UCI and UCI Health. Adherence to the guidelines of the CCSG is mandatory and involves ongoing monitoring of the organization for structure, direction, and fiscal management. All decisions at the CFCCC are taken within the context of the CCSG requirements.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across UC Irvine and the Health System with leadership, faculty, staff and students.
* Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job.

new_jobs.title: Employee Benefits Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding an Employee Benefits Account Manager** **to their** **Corporate Synergies** **team in the New York City** **Metro Region.**

The Account Manager is a client-facing position responsible for managing day-to-day service activities for an assigned book of business. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and Underwriting, this role supports client retention, satisfaction, and growth through proactive relationship management and service delivery.

**Essential Functions:**

* Manage the client life-cycle deliverables with oversight from the Benefit Consultant and Team Lead to ensure the successful retention of a Book of Business (94% Renewal Rate).
* With guidance and supervision, work on client related deliverables of increasing complexity.
* Beyond foundational knowledge (i.e., industry, product knowledge and regulatory compliance), complete necessary training and professional development to gain exposure to principles such as strategic account planning, effective communication and project management.
* Identify and declare area of focus/subject matter expertise.
* Maintain up-to-date client files/internal systems in accordance with CSG's standard protocols.
* Compliance with CSG's processes and operating standards.

**Essential Duties:**

* As part of the client life cycle (on-boarding, ongoing support and renewal), work closely with the Team to execute on the day-to-day service deliverables for ALL lines of coverage and products by:
  + Supporting the Team Lead to understand a client's goals/objectives and develop a multi-year strategic plan (roadmap)
  + Defining an annual service delivery calendar (life cycle) in support of the multi-year strategic plan (roadmap)
  + Preparing the various deliverables by leveraging team member expertise, available tools, established standards/work products, etc. to manage client expectations and ensure timely delivery of materials in accordance with the client life cycle
  + Effectively communicating and presenting findings, analysis and recommendations in meetings/calls/emails (i.e., setting agendas and appropriate internal/external follow-up)
  + Prepare standard and ad-hoc reports and other client related projects (as needed)
  + Developing, cultivating and maintaining strong client/vendor relationships
* At various times throughout the year (i.e., Open Enrollment), review employee education and communication materials (i.e., Benefit Guides).
* Research, respond and/or resolve client inquiries/service-related issues independently, involving more experienced team members and resources when necessary.
* Maintain internal systems (i.e., BenefitPoint and Oracle) and client files in accordance with CSG's data standards and filing requirements.
* Ensure that contact information for all client stakeholders is appropriately managed for purposes of both Client Satisfaction (NPS) and Thought Leadership.
* In order to identify/overcome gaps, work with Team Lead and Producer to create and periodically review/update/manage Internal Account Plan.
* Interact with carriers and vendors on behalf of the client and the team.
* Ability to identify and leverage resources appropriate for upsell opportunities.
* Responsible for reconciling client revenue monthly (BenefitPoint vs. Finance Accrued Revenue).
* Develop new and creative benefit solutions with guidance.

**Competencies & Qualifications:**

* Strong attention to detail, well organized and responsive
* Ability to model financial implications from benefit programs
* Comfortable in negotiating with insurance carriers
* Ability to identify problems and create effective solutions
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to quickly learn new skills
* Works collaboratively with a team as well as independently, capable of meeting deadlines and delegating when necessary,
* Ability to establish relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and demonstrate composure/resilience under pressure - Comfortable switching between clients and tasks to meet deadlines
* Possesses a basic understanding of general business and financial concepts
* Ability to effectively create, organize and manage a project plan
* Basic understanding of strategy and long-term planning

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* 3+ years of prior practical account management experience with a health and welfare carrier or broker is required
* State Specific Resident Life & Health License is required

**Disclaimer:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**

FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.

**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays & 2 floating holidays!

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About Oath**

Oath is the strategic giving platform designed to help donors maximize the impact of their contributions by guiding them to the races and causes where their dollars can make the greatest impact. Oath has directed over $150M while protecting donors' data and avoiding the spam and spin of other giving platforms. As the one stop shop for a generation of donors who want to make a difference, Oath is building the future of philanthropy.

### **The Opportunity**

You'll run the channels that bring new grassroots donors into Oath and turn existing donors into recruiters. Your mission is to grow Oath's donor base through paid media and peer-to-peer programs while building a community of donors who share Oath with their networks. The role is about 70% paid media and peer-to-peer marketing and 30% community building. You'll own budgets, test fast, and report what works, with the 2028 presidential cycle as the biggest acquisition moment in Oath's history. You'll have the autonomy to build these programs your way, with the support of the Head of Growth and a team across email, social, and creator partnerships.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the donor journey**: Own the experience from first impression to sign-up, including what donors see in ads and how they experience Oath at every step after.
* **Own paid media**: Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google, and emerging platforms. Own budget allocation, targeting, creative testing, pacing, forecasting, and cost-per-donor goals. Set a specific strategy for each funnel stage, build new audiences to reach new donor archetypes, and plan around reach, saturation, and the cost to acquire a new donor, not just ROAS.
* **Build community, ambassadors, and the peer-to-peer program**: Manage Oath’s community spaces and give donors who want to do more a clear way to get involved. Find, train, and support the volunteer ambassadors and creators who bring new donors to Oath. Launch and run donor-to-donor texting, referral campaigns, giving circles, and shareable race pages that turn donors into bundlers.
* **Write, test, and optimize**: Draft and iterate ad copy, landing pages, and P2P scripts in Oath’s voice: direct, data-grounded, and never alarmist. Work with engineering and product to design landing page tests, run structured A/B tests, and drive conversion rate optimization. Get excited about building and optimizing routines with AI tools.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Work closely with Email & Lifecycle, Social & Creator Partnerships, and Partnerships so every channel tells one story. Be comfortable in HubSpot and collaborate with lifecycle marketing on CRM.
* **Time campaigns and support earned media**: Plan pushes around major national cultural and political events, and help broaden our reach through earned media, exploring new efforts and tracking the results.
* **Report, measure, and iterate**: Own weekly reporting on spend, cost per donor, conversion, and retention by channel, with a clear story of what moved and why. Own measurement across the full top-of-funnel team (community, influencer and affiliate, events), and build a scorecard leadership can trust. Understand our economics well enough to shift budget to what performs.

  
**Requirements**  

* **Strong background**: You have 3+ years in any of the following: paid digital, performance marketing, or digital fundraising (ideally for political, advocacy, or nonprofit organizations); growth roles at leading tech or consumer companies; MBB consulting; investment banking; or VC/PE. Your background signals exceptional caliber.
* **High ba**r: You hold yourself accountable for both quality and results, and you’re comfortable pushing beyond the obvious idea.
* **Hands-on operator**: You have a proven track record managing paid budgets with strong ROI, and you’re data-literate: you can read dashboards, interpret metrics, and turn data into decisions. Hands-on experience with peer-to-peer texting or relational organizing tools is a plus, and so is experience building or moderating online communities.
* **Strong writer**: You’re comfortable drafting and testing creative in a set brand voice.
* **Thinker and doer**: You have a bias toward action, like being scrappy and creative, and connect the dots across the org. No task is too small or too big.
* **Mission-driven and winning mindset**: You’re excited about politics & civic engagement and you get excited about every new donor we reach
* **Management experience**: Have management experience or are open to managing interns!

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Base Salary: $100,000-$125,000
* Equity package
* Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k) matching
* Time Off: Flexible PTO
* Office: 3 days per week in our NYC headquarters; flexible remote work for the other 2 days

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

HUNTER COLLEGE

Bargaining Unit:

No

The New York City Administration for Children’s Services’ Office of Training and Workforce Development (ACS’s OTWD) and City University of New York Hunter College Silberman School of Social Work have entered an exciting partnership! Together they have launched initiatives that both strengthen leaders working within public and private child welfare and juvenile justice agencies in New York City, and support and evaluate the transfer of learning strategies for the Office of Training and Workforce Development (OTWD). ACS’s OTWD is a state-of-the-art professional development institute that deepens knowledge, strengthens skills, and provides support to child welfare and juvenile justice staff as they strengthen and support New York City's children, youth, families and communities. OTWD seeks a full-time Program Operations Assistant to support the operations of these joint initiatives. Reporting to the Senior Operations Manager, this individual will support the planning, outreach, implementation and reporting of the programs using systems such as Smartsheet, Cornerstone and Canva.
  
  
Responsibilities of this position include:

* Develop engagement and outreach materials for prospective participants, partners and stakeholders.
* Effectively manage communication and queries re: programming, often serving as the first point of contact for the team.
* Develop and distribute event materials (e.g. presentation decks, handouts), agendas, and attendee information in advance of the events.
* Coordinate locations, booking, and logistics for in-person events, including set up and breakdown.
* Coordinate with vendors for catering, audio-visual, and other event services
* Provide technical support to participants and facilitators for virtual meetings.
* Track and report event attendance in the program systems, ensuring accuracy and completeness in cornerstone and other systems.
* Assist evaluation team in delivering evaluations.
* Use problem-solving skills to assist instructors and learners with technical issues. Ensure the effectiveness of support procedures. Create/Modify these procedures as necessary.
* Respond promptly to email, phone calls, and voicemail messages.
* Identify, analyze and troubleshoot challenges effectively. Perform due diligence by researching questions using available information and resources.
* Use effective tools and techniques to manage day-to-day responsibilities.
Attend trainings and meetings as indicated and perform other duties as needed.  

  

High school diploma/GED required. Bachelor's degree preferred.

  

Currently on hybrid schedule with daily schedule 9am-5pm, with some flexibility required for event days.

Applicants are asked to submit a cover letter that details how your qualifications match this position description along with a resume.

Pay Range:

Minimum - Maximum: $45,000 - $55,000

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

* Your daily tasks will include responding to guests' requests in a timely, friendly and efficient manner; word processing, typing, e-mailing, data entry, filing, faxing, copying, and processing mail; other general office duties and assisting with special projects, as needed.
* Your boss is the Director of Sales.
* A coordinator role is an excellent entry-level position in the sales department because you learn about all aspects of sales, catering, and CS, as well as the operation of the entire hotel. This position can set you up for a progressive career in the sales discipline. It is also a good job for someone who likes to leave work behind at the end of the shift.

* Availability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays if needed
* A warm, professional demeanor that reflects HVMG’s **Culture of Excellence**
  

This position may require a varied schedule, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Please share your scheduling needs.

* Career growth opportunities across our nationwide portfolio
* Flexible scheduling
* Access up to 40% of your earned wages before payday with **PayActive**
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
* Full healthcare benefits: medical, dental, and vision

Our **Be Excellent culture** is more than just words on a website - we live and breathe it. As one associate said in an anonymous survey, \"This is **the best management company** I've ever worked for. They walk the talk from the corporate office to the field.\"

new_jobs.description:
**We’re People People. Are you?**

We’re Sonesta International Hotels—the 8th largest hotel company in the U.S. (and growing fast ).

  

With a dynamic mix of full-service and focused hotels across major cities, our diverse portfolio of owned, managed, and franchised properties means we’re everywhere our guests need us to be.

But here’s the thing—we’re not just in the business of hotels, we’re in the business of people. We bring service with passion, loyalty with purpose, and create experiences that genuinely connect—delivering quality, value, and memorable stays across 1,000+ properties in eight countries (and counting).

  
  

**What this role is all about**

  
At Sonesta, our Sales & Marketing teams help bring the brand to life — building relationships, driving revenue, and creating excitement around our hotels, restaurants, meetings, and guest experiences. As the Sales & Marketing Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day coordination of sales, marketing, events, and commercial activities that help keep the hotel connected, visible, and growing.
  
  
This role is perfect for someone who’s organized, creative, detail-oriented, and excited to grow their career in hospitality sales and marketing. You’ll support client communication, marketing initiatives, social content, reporting, events, sales coordination, and administrative operations across the commercial team.
  
  
If you’re energetic, collaborative, and passionate about hospitality, branding, and relationship-building — we’d love to meet you.  
  
  

**What you’ll be doing**

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support daily sales and marketing operations including administrative coordination, client communication, reporting, and event support.

* Assist with business transient, group, catering, and corporate sales activities including proposals, contracts, site tours, and lead management.

* Coordinate marketing initiatives, promotional campaigns, social media support, email marketing, and hotel collateral updates.

* Maintain CRM systems, account records, sales activity tracking, pipeline updates, and revenue reporting accurately and efficiently.

* Support the planning and execution of hotel events, networking opportunities, client meetings, trade shows, and community partnerships.

* Respond to client inquiries, coordinate follow-up communication, and help support exceptional customer service throughout the sales process.

* Maintain organization of sales files, contracts, marketing assets, calendars, and operational systems.

* Help foster a collaborative, energetic, and guest-focused culture aligned with Sonesta’s People People philosophy.

* Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

* Experience using Microsoft Office, CRM systems, social media platforms, and marketing tools preferred.

* Strong attention to detail with excellent administrative and coordination skills.

* Creative mindset with an interest in branding, marketing, hospitality trends, and guest engagement.

* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and support both operational and commercial teams.

* Flexible availability including occasional evenings, weekends, networking events, and hotel functions as needed.

Additional Perks & Employee Discounts
