new_jobs.title: Route Account Executive (Sales & Account Management)
new_jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Account Executive in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Benefits: Dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, mileage reimbursement, paid time off, vision insurance

Schedule: Monday to Friday; weekend availability as needed

Supplemental Pay: Commission pay, bonus pay

Ability to commute/relocate: Atlanta, GA

Experience: Route sales or territory sales: 1 year (Required); Account management: 1 year (Preferred); B2B sales or staffing industry: 1 year (Preferred)

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

new_jobs.description:
Position Description: Customer Account Manager (CAM)

Job Description

The Customer Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and represents their needs throughout the organization. This role builds lasting relationships and coordinates the internal activities required to deliver responsive, accurate service for technically engineered systems, from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment and post-delivery support.

Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Production Planning, Purchasing, Quality, Logistics, and Finance, the Customer Account Manager translates customer requests into clear actions of supporting teams, establishes ownership and timelines, and follows through to resolution. Success requires technical aptitude, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across departments while keeping customers informed.

Key Responsibilities

* Customer relationships: Develop a thorough understanding of assigned accounts, their applications, business priorities, and service expectations. Maintain regular communication, build trust, and serve as the central contact for day-to-day requests and escalations.
* Cross-functional coordination: Translate customer needs into documented requirements, deliverables, owners, and due dates. Coordinate internal follow-up, resolve handoff gaps, and escalate competing priorities or overdue actions to the appropriate leaders.
* Records and improvement: Maintain accurate customer, quotation, order, and issue records in CRM and ERP systems. Share recurring customer feedback and recommend improvements to communication, service, and internal workflows.

Qualifications

* Experience in customer account management, technical customer service, inside sales, project coordination, or a similar role supporting business customers in manufacturing or an engineered-product environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, open orders, and requests with different priorities and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information, communicate delays, and handle difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using CRM, ERP, or order management systems.
* Experience supporting distributors, contractors, OEMs, or other commercial and industrial customers.

Measures of Success

* Timely acknowledgment, tracking, and resolution of customer requests, with clear ownership of open actions.
* Effective coordination of customer issues through corrective action and confirmed closure.
* Strong customer satisfaction and retention, with support for repeat business and account growth.

new_jobs.description:
**About ThredUp**

ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.

Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022.

**The Role**

ThredUp is turning secondhand browsing into a live, shoppable experience. Buyers watch a real person pull real inventory in real time, and we’re building ThredUp Live from the ground up. As a Production Assistant, you’re the hands-on team that makes every show run. Working inside our distribution center, you’ll reserve and stage the inventory, set up the studio, and run the auctions and chat while we’re live. After each show, you’ll hand items back to the DC team for reinduction. You’ll report to the Live Selling and Social Commerce Manager, who sets the strategy, show plan, and direction for the program. You’ll be the steady on-site presence that makes it happen day after day. This is a full-time, on-site role on our AM shift, and it’s a chance to help build a new business line from the start.

**In This Role You’ll Get To**

* Reserve and stage inventory for each day’s shows, working from the show plan provided by the Live Selling Manager
* Prep the live studio before the first show and reset it between shows so every show starts clean and on time
* Run the auctions during each live show, keeping bidding moving and the pace on track
* Monitor the chat throughout the show, answer viewer questions, and flag requests to the host
* Partner with Live Sellers Hosts and the Live Selling and Social Commerce Manager on show-day decisions, and run show operations on your own on days when the Manager isn’t on-site
* Notify the DC team after every show so items are ready for reinduction
* Track what sold fast, what didn’t, and what viewers asked for, and share it with the Live Selling Manager to help shape the next show
* Flag technical, inventory, or workflow issues quickly so the team can fix them and improve how shows run

**What We’re Looking For**

* Comfortable and focused through 3-hour live shows, with sustained attention the whole time
* Quick on your feet: you can multitask, handle a fast-moving chat, and stay calm in a live environment
* Strong attention to detail when reserving, staging, and tracking items
* Comfortable in a warehouse environment: on your feet, handling inventory, and moving at a fast pace
* Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools, including live selling platforms and chat moderation
* Able to work in ambiguity and adapt as we build a new program and the process evolves
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to coordinate with Hosts, the Live Selling and Social Commerce Manager, and the DC team
* An interest in fashion, secondhand, and sustainability
* Experience in a distribution center, fulfillment, or inventory environment, or with live selling platforms such as Whatnot or other platforms is a plus
* Demonstrated ability in keeping business, team and customer information confidential
* Role models independent judgment and operates with minimal supervision
* Experience giving and receiving constructive feedback and proactively following-up with team members, peers, and leaders
* Able to stand or walk for an entire shift (8-12 hours per day) as well as bend down, reach overhead, lift/carry up to 30lbs and push/pull wheeled clothing racks weighing up to 150lbs

**Schedule**

* Full-time, on-site at ThredUp’s distribution centers in the Atlanta area (Suwanee, GA)
* AM shift: covering the first show(s) of the day
* A short overlap between shifts for handoff
* Shows run 5-6 days per week, scheduled around peak viewer traffic, so a rotating schedule is required

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**What We Offer:**

* 4-day work week, with Fridays off
* Hybrid work environment: 3 days in the office and 1 day remote each week
* Competitive salary (we leverage market data)
* Many ThredUp employees also have the opportunity to own shares of ThredUp stock and are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Flexible PTO (take the time you need) + 13 company holidays
* Paid Sabbatical after 3 years of full time employment
* Generous paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers
* Medical, dental, vision, 401k, life and disability insurance offered
* We live by our Core Values of Transparency, SpeakingUP, Thinking Big, Infinite Learning, Influencing Outcomes & Seeking the Truth

**We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team**

Your day begins at the office, where you’ll connect with your team, prepare for the day ahead, and follow up with existing customer accounts before heading into your assigned territory. * Commission earned on new accounts

Chicago, IL  
15–18 hours per week  
$22–$25/hour, depending on experience

Growing Chicago residential property management company is looking for a reliable, organized and hands-on **Property Operations Coordinator**.

This role is primarily focused on **maintenance, unit turnovers, property walkthroughs, vendors and day-to-day property operations**, with leasing support as a secondary responsibility.

We already have administrative support, so this is not a general office or bookkeeping position.

**Primary Responsibilities – Property Operations**

* Coordinate maintenance requests from start to completion
* Schedule and follow up with contractors and vendors
* Coordinate apartment access with residents and contractors
* Communicate with residents regarding maintenance and scheduling
* Track open work orders and make sure issues are completed
* Conduct routine property and common-area walkthroughs
* Identify and document maintenance or building issues
* Conduct move-in and move-out unit walkthroughs and document condition with photos
* Coordinate unit turnovers, including repairs, painting and cleaning
* Create and follow up on turnover punch lists
* Inspect completed contractor and vendor work
* Perform final walkthroughs to make sure units are rent-ready before move-in
* Help manage keys, locks, fobs and building access
* Obtain completion photos, invoices and other documentation
* Follow up on unresolved property issues until completed
* Escalate major repairs, resident disputes and unusual situations to the property manager

**Secondary Responsibilities – Leasing Support**

* Conduct apartment showings as needed
* Help schedule and coordinate showings
* Make sure vacant units are clean and presentable before showings
* Follow up with prospective residents after showings
* Assist with move-in coordination after a lease is signed
* Help with other leasing-related tasks during periods of higher vacancy

**What We're Looking For**

* Property management, maintenance coordination, leasing, real estate, construction or similar experience preferred
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills
* Comfortable working with residents, prospective residents, contractors and vendors
* Able to work independently and solve routine problems
* Good eye for property condition and maintenance issues
* Professional communication skills
* Comfortable using email, text and property management software
* Reliable transportation and ability to travel between Chicago properties
* Dependable, responsive and able to manage multiple open items at once

Experience with **Rent Manager** or other property management software is helpful but not required.

This position has the opportunity to grow in hours and responsibility as our property management portfolio grows.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the President & CEO
new_jobs.description:
***Executive Assistant to the President & CEO***

  

Reporting to the President & Chief Executive Officer, the Executive Assistant provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to the CEO and serves as a key partner in advancing organizational priorities. The position manages the CEO's schedule, communications, meetings, travel, and follow-through on strategic commitments while ensuring the Executive Office operates efficiently. The Executive Assistant also coordinates the Executive Leadership Team's (ELT) activities and operating cadence, supports Board and governance functions, and facilitates communication and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. This role requires exceptional discretion, sound judgment, organizational excellence, and the ability to effectively manage competing priorities in a complex, multi-state human services organization.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Executive Support**

* Manage the CEO's calendar, travel, meetings, correspondence, and administrative priorities.
* Coordinate and prepare agendas, briefing materials, presentations, reports, and executive communications.
* Monitor and track key commitments, deadlines, decisions, and follow-up actions on behalf of the CEO.
* Evaluate and prioritize requests for the CEO's time and attention, ensuring matters are appropriately addressed or delegated.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest degree of discretion and professionalism.

**Executive Leadership Team Coordination**

* Coordinate the Executive Leadership Team's meeting schedule, annual planning calendar, and related activities.
* Facilitate agenda development, meeting preparation, documentation, and follow-up.
* Maintain records of key discussions, decisions, action items, and organizational commitments.
* Support leadership retreats, strategic planning sessions, and other executive meetings.

**Board & Governance Support**

* Coordinate logistics, scheduling, communications, and materials for Board and committee meetings involving the CEO.
* Support the preparation and distribution of governance-related materials, including meeting agendas, minutes, and supporting documentation.
* Track and monitor CEO commitments arising from Board and committee activities.
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of governance-related information and records.

**Stakeholder Relations & Advancement Support**

* Serve as a professional liaison between the Executive Office and internal and external stakeholders, including Board members, donors, funders, government officials, community partners, and organizational leaders.
* Coordinate meetings, communications, and follow-up activities involving the CEO.
* Support fundraising, donor engagement, advocacy, public affairs, and partnership initiatives involving the CEO.
* Facilitate preparation and follow-through related to stakeholder meetings, events, and strategic engagements.

**Executive Office Administration & Special Projects**

* Maintain organized systems, records, and processes that support Executive Office operations.
* Conduct research and prepare briefing materials, reports, and executive summaries.
* Coordinate special projects, leadership initiatives, conferences, and organizational events as assigned.
* Identify and implement improvements that enhance efficiency, communication, and administrative effectiveness.
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**Note:** This list of essential functions is not exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

  

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, communication, organizational leadership, or a related field preferred.

* An equivalent combination of education and relevant executive support experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible administrative or executive-support experience.

* At least three years supporting a CEO, President, C-suite executive, or other senior organizational leader strongly preferred.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex executive calendars, senior-level meetings, meeting materials, notes, and action-item follow-up.

* Experience handling confidential and sensitive information and coordinating work across multiple senior leaders or departments.

* Experience supporting a Board of Directors or Board committees preferred.

* Experience in nonprofit human services, healthcare, education, child welfare, or another complex, regulated organization preferred.

**Certifications/Licensure**

* N/A

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours based on CEO, Board, or organizational needs.

* Ability to travel periodically for Board meetings, leadership meetings, conferences, or organizational events as required.

  

**Required Skills**

* Exceptional organizational, planning, and project-management abilities.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated judgment, discretion, and ability to manage highly confidential information.
* Ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and ensure timely follow-through.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills with executives, Board members, and external stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 and other business productivity technologies.
* High degree of professionalism, accuracy, accountability, and attention to detail.

**We Invest in You!**

* Tuition assistance up to $2500 per fiscal year
* Up to 4 weeks paid Vacation Days, up to 6 paid Personal Days, 1 paid Mental Health Day, and up to 5 paid Sick days annually
* Medical, dental, vision, 403 (b) retirement, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, dependent care, commuter and transit
* Agency-paid Life&ADD insurance up to $50K based on salary and short-term disability
* Agency-paid long-term after 1 year of employment
